value: Does students' interest in learning mathematics mediate the relationships between mathematics learning motivation, peer assisted learning, and teaching quality on the one hand and performance in mathematics on the other?

A questionnaire survey of 373 Ghanaian first-year undergraduates analysed by structural equation modelling, showing that student interest in mathematics partially mediates the effects of learning motivation and teaching quality on mathematics performance and fully mediates the effect of peer-assisted learning, which had no direct effect.

quote: The study design was a survey, with structured questionnaire being used for data collection.

It was concluded that students learning interest in mathematics partially mediated the relationships between mathematics learning motivation and performance in mathematics; as well as between mathematics teaching quality and performance in mathematics.
This study therefore explored the role of motivation, peer assisted learning, quality of teaching and student interest on student performance in mathematics.
